text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for giving me the day off 
yesterday. I was able to spend it 
relaxing, thanks to you.
choice_data_list: Did you get some proper rest?
Did you get some proper rest?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Finished up all my dorm head duties, and 
gave some advice to the little pony-chans 
too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides that, going one-on-one with Hishi 
Ama, watching Opera O's one-man show—
choice_data_list: Did that actually count as... rest?
Did you actually get to... rest?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Entertaining everyone and 
having fun together is the greatest rest 
of all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems that in her own way, she was able 
to let loose and unwind.
